([[Southfield, Michigan]]) | college = [[Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball|Iowa]] (2010–2014) | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_pick = | draft_team = | career_start = | years1 = | team1 = | highlights = *First Team All-[[Big Ten Conference|Big Ten]] (2014) }} '''Roy Devyn Marble''' (born September 21, 1992) is an American [[basketball]] player who last played for the [[Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball]] team. He was regarded as one of the best players in the country, being named to the All-[[Big Ten Conference]] First Team during his final year in college.{{cite web|url=http://www.hawkeyesports.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/roy_devyn_marble_712988.html |title=Roy Devyn Marble Bio - Hawkeye Sports Official Athletic Site |publisher=Hawkeyesports.com |date= |accessdate=2014-06-03}} Marble had led the Hawkeyes in scoring in his final two seasons representing the [[University of Iowa]].{{cite web|url=http://espn.go.com/mens-college-basketball/team/stats/_/id/2294/year/2013/iowa-hawkeyes |title=Iowa Hawkeyes 2012-13 Statistics - Team and Player Stats - Men's College Basketball - ESPN |publisher=Espn.go.com |date= |accessdate=2014-06-03}} According to several sports columnists, Roy Devyn Marble will be a first-round pick in the [[2014 NBA Draft]]. == Personal == On March 9, 2013, he and his father, [[Roy Marble]], became the first father-son duo to record 1,000 points each in Big Ten Conference history.{{cite web|url=http://www.foxnews.com/sports/2013/03/09/iowa-devyn-marble-joins-father-roy-in-scoring-1000th-point-for-hawkeyes/ |title=Iowa's Devyn Marble joins father Roy in scoring 1,000th point for Hawkeyes |publisher=Fox News |date=2013-03-09 |accessdate=2014-06-03}} == References == {{Reflist}} {{Persondata | NAME = Marble, Roy Devyn | ALTERNATIVE NAMES = | SHORT DESCRIPTION = | DATE OF BIRTH = September 21, 1992 | PLACE OF BIRTH = Southfield, Michigan | DATE OF DEATH = | PLACE OF DEATH = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Marble, Roy Devyn}} [[Category:1992 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Basketball players from Michigan]] [[Category:Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball players]] [[Category:People from Southfield, Michigan]] [[Category:Shooting guards]] [[Category:Small forwards]]
